```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(moments)

set.seed(20260105)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

DATA_DIR <- "data"
OUT_DIR  <- "outputs"
FIG_DIR  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "figures")
TAB_DIR  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables")

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(FIG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(TAB_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

dat <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "updated_data.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    coop = factor(coop, levels = c("Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored")),
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), ordered = TRUE),
    across(c(oa, fund, LS, SS, PS, HS), as.integer)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(coop))

dat_core <- dat |> filter(coop != "Hyperauthored")
dat_fig <- dat_core |> filter(year >= 2000)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-profile


fmt_iqr <- function(x) {
  qs <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  paste0(comma(qs[[2]]), " (", comma(qs[[1]]), "–", comma(qs[[3]]), ")")
}

fmt_n_pct <- function(n, d) {
  paste0(comma(n), " (", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n / d), "%)")
}

mode_stats <- bind_rows(
  dat |> mutate(mode = as.character(coop)),
  dat |> mutate(mode = "Total")
) |>
  group_by(mode) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_auth_iqr = fmt_iqr(n_authors),
    n_ctry_iqr = fmt_iqr(n_countries),
    oa_n = sum(oa == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fund_n = sum(fund == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_n = sum(quartile == "Q1", na.rm = TRUE),
    q2_n = sum(quartile == "Q2", na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_n = sum(quartile == "Q3", na.rm = TRUE),
    q4_n = sum(quartile == "Q4", na.rm = TRUE),
    LS_n = sum(LS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    SS_n = sum(SS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    PS_n = sum(PS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    HS_n = sum(HS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-volume-fields

d <- dat |> filter(year >= 2000)

mode_year <- d |> count(year, coop, name = "n_mode")

field_year <- d |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    LS = sum(LS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    SS = sum(SS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    PS = sum(PS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    HS = sum(HS == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(c(LS, SS, PS, HS), names_to = "field", values_to = "count") |>
  mutate(
    field = case_when(
      field == "LS" ~ "Life Sciences",
      field == "SS" ~ "Social Sciences",
      field == "PS" ~ "Physical Sciences",
      field == "HS" ~ "Health Sciences"
    )
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = mode_year, aes(x = year, y = n_mode, fill = coop), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = field_year, aes(x = year, y = count, color = field), linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(2014, 2023), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = 2014, y = Inf, label = "VJU\n2014", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 2023, y = Inf, label = "Strategic\nPartnership\n2023", hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Collaboration mode", 
                    values = c("Bilateral" = "#2166ac", "Multilateral" = "#67a9cf", "Hyperauthored" = "#f4a582")) +
  scale_color_brewer(name = "Research field", palette = "Set2") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Publications (count)", expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1), color = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-quality

dat_fig |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  count(year, quartile) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    share = n / sum(n),
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1"))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  {
    \(d) {
      q1_2000 <- d |> filter(year == 2000, quartile == "Q1") |> pull(share)
      q1_2023 <- d |> filter(year == 2023, quartile == "Q1") |> pull(share)
      
      ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = share, fill = quartile)) +
        geom_area(alpha = 0.8) +
        annotate("text", x = 2000, y = q1_2000/2, label = sprintf("Q1: %.0f%%", q1_2000*100),
                 hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
        annotate("text", x = 2023, y = 1 - q1_2023/2, label = sprintf("Q1: %.0f%%", q1_2023*100),
                 hjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, color = "gray20", fontface = "bold") +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = c("Q1" = "#1a9850", "Q2" = "#91cf60", "Q3" = "#fee08b", "Q4" = "#fc8d59"),
          breaks = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(2000, 2023)) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Share", fill = NULL)
    }
  }()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-oa

dat_fig |>
  count(year, oa) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    share = n / sum(n),
    oa_status = factor(if_else(oa == 1, "OA", "Non-OA"), levels = c("Non-OA", "OA"))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  {
    \(d) {
      oa_2000 <- d |> filter(year == 2000, oa == 1) |> pull(share)
      oa_2023 <- d |> filter(year == 2023, oa == 1) |> pull(share)
      
      ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = share, fill = oa_status)) +
        geom_area(alpha = 0.85) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
        annotate("text", x = 2001, y = 0.52, label = "50% parity", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
        annotate("text", x = 2000, y = oa_2000/2, label = sprintf("OA: %.0f%%", oa_2000*100),
                 hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
        annotate("text", x = 2023, y = 1 - oa_2023/2, label = sprintf("OA: %.0f%%", oa_2023*100),
                 hjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, color = "gray20", fontface = "bold") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("OA" = "#1b9e77", "Non-OA" = "#7f7f7f")) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Share", fill = NULL)
    }
  }()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-equity

dat_fig |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    `Vietnam (fractional)` = mean(fc_vn, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Japan (fractional)` = mean(fc_jp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "series", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(series = factor(series, levels = c("Vietnam (fractional)", "Japan (fractional)"))) |>
  {
    \(d) {
      vn_2000 <- d |> filter(year == 2000, series == "Vietnam (fractional)") |> pull(value)
      vn_2023 <- d |> filter(year == 2023, series == "Vietnam (fractional)") |> pull(value)
      
      ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = value, color = series)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
        annotate("text", x = 2000, y = vn_2000, label = sprintf("%.0f%%", vn_2000*100),
                 hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, color = "#1B9E77", fontface = "bold") +
        annotate("text", x = 2023, y = vn_2023, label = sprintf("%.0f%%", vn_2023*100),
                 hjust = -0.2, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, color = "#1B9E77", fontface = "bold") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Vietnam (fractional)" = "#1B9E77", "Japan (fractional)" = "#D95F02")) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fractional share", color = NULL) +
        theme(legend.position = c(0.70, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
              legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray80"))
    }
  }()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-leadership

dat_fig |>
  summarise(
    .by = year,
    `Vietnam — First author` = mean(fa_vn, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-descriptive

cite_stats <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    P99 = quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_zero = 100 * mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

impact_stats <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    skewness = skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    kurtosis = kurtosis(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

bind_rows(
  dat_core |> summarise(Variable = "Overall", Category = "All", N = n(), 
                       bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))),
  dat_core |> filter(LS == 1) |> summarise(Variable = "Field", Category = "Life Sciences", N = n(),
                                           bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))),
  dat_core |> filter(SS == 1) |> summarise(Variable = "", Category = "Social Sciences", N = n(),
                                           bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))),
  dat_core |> filter(PS == 1) |> summarise(Variable = "", Category = "Physical Sciences", N = n(),
                                           bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))),
  dat_core |> filter(HS == 1) |> summarise(Variable = "", Category = "Health Sciences", N = n(),
                                           bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))),
  dat_core |> filter(!is.na(quartile)) |> summarise(.by = quartile, N = n(),
                                                     bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))) |>
    mutate(Variable = c("Quartile", rep("", n()-1)), Category = as.character(quartile)) |> select(-quartile),
  dat_core |> summarise(.by = oa, N = n(), bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))) |>
    mutate(Variable = c("OA", ""), Category = if_else(oa == 1, "Yes", "No")) |> select(-oa),
  dat_core |> summarise(.by = fund, N = n(), bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))) |>
    mutate(Variable = c("Fund", ""), Category = if_else(fund == 1, "Yes", "No")) |> select(-fund),
  dat_core |> summarise(.by = coop, N = n(), bind_cols(cite_stats(cited))) |>
    mutate(Variable = c("Coop", ""), Category = as.character(coop)) |> select(-coop)
) |>
  mutate(
    N = comma(N),
    across(c(median, IQR, P99, min, max), ~comma(., accuracy = 1)),
    pct_zero = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_zero),
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Variable", "Category", "N", "Median", "IQR", "P99", "Min", "Max", "% Zero"),
    align = c("l", "l", "r", rep("r", 10))
  )
```
